authority: CLAUDE.md §9.4 (durable decision), §11.3 (call consistency), §12.2 (status vocabulary), §12.3 (contradiction resolution). Operator instruction of 2026-08-29 following the gate_12 failure (g11_p11, g11_p13).
title: Revision-cycle corrections for the two gate_12 semantic failures: Tier 2B/Tier 3 EI-05 identifier collision in Impact 2.2, and the AgroVIR production-footprint claim masked as Confirmed in Excellence 1.3

corrections.claim: Impact 2.2 asserted the fellowship's measures serve expected impact EI-05 ('(EI-05, EI-06)' in the audiences paragraph; 'serves EI-05 and EI-06' in the fit summary; claims c2 and c19).
corrections.root_cause: Identifier-namespace collision, not a nuclear-impact assertion. Tier 3 architecture_inputs/impacts.json numbers its own expected_impact_coverage entries EI-01..EI-06, and its EI-05 is 'Increased R&I capacity, output and knowledge transfer among European research organisations'. Tier 2B extracted/expected_impacts.json assigns EI-05 to the call slice's Euratom scope ('Enhanced nuclear expertise ... through Euratom-supported fellowships in nuclear research areas'), which is inapplicable to this agricultural MSCA-PF fellowship. Phase 5 already flagged the id-vs-description conflict: impact_architecture.json carries pathway IP-EI-05 as coverage_status 'uncovered_flagged' / validation_status 'Unresolved', with the R&I-capacity content carried by IP-EI-06. The 2.2 drafter cited the Tier 3 numbering in evaluator-facing text, where EI-xx reads as the Tier 2B id.
corrections.resolution: Evaluator-facing identifiers must use the Tier 2B namespace (§11.3: Tier 2B governs call-specific framing). All four EI-05 citations in section_drafts/impact/2.2.draft.json were re-pointed to EI-06, which is the Tier 2B id that carries the knowledge-transfer / R&I-capacity content the prose actually claims: prose '(EI-05, EI-06)' -> '(EI-06)'; prose 'serves EI-05 and EI-06' -> 'serves EI-06'; claim c2 'EO-03/EI-03, EI-05, EI-06' -> 'EO-03/EI-03, EI-06'; claim c19 'EI-02, EI-03, EI-05, EI-06' -> 'EI-02, EI-03, EI-06'. No substantive impact claim was added or removed.
corrections.retained: The section's impact_pathway_refs enumeration (spine) retains IP-EI-05: it references the Phase 5 pathway record, which itself declares the Euratom impact uncovered_flagged with the id-conflict stated. Listing the flagged-uncovered pathway is the honest declaration (§11.5), not a coverage assertion; the gate finding did not cite it.
corrections.not_done: Tier 3 impacts.json was NOT renumbered to the Tier 2B namespace. That would ripple through Phase 5 outputs and require phase reruns; the cross-identifier correspondence is already stated in impact_architecture.json (IP-EI-06 tier3_linkage_ref).

corrections.claim: Excellence 1.3 carried the AgroVIR 745,000-hectare FMIS production footprint as claim 'agrovir_production_footprint', status 'confirmed', sourced to consortium/capabilities.json, while Impact and Implementation carry the identical fact as the operator-declared Assumed claim 'agrovir_relevant_track_record' (working_assumptions.json, pending AgroVIR's written confirmation).
corrections.root_cause: Tier 3 itself is split on this fact: capabilities.json capacity_statements CAP5 states the footprint with validation_status 'Confirmed' ('carried forward from the company's published figures'), while the same file's participant_capacity VALIDATION_PARTNER record carries relevant_track_record_status 'Assumed' with declaration key 'agrovir_relevant_track_record', matching the working_assumptions.json declaration ('operator's declared position pending the company's written confirmation'). The Excellence drafter cited CAP5; the Impact/Implementation drafters cited the declaration.
corrections.resolution: Assumed prevails (§12.3): the operator's own declaration states the fact is adopted pending written confirmation, and no evidence artifact for the 'published figures' provenance is filed in the repository; under §12.2 a fact awaiting confirmation cannot be Confirmed, and the downgrade direction cannot mask a gap. The Excellence 1.3 claim was re-keyed to the declaration exactly as runner/assumption_applier.py would have produced it: claim_id 'agrovir_relevant_track_record', claim_summary = the declared value verbatim, status 'assumed', source_ref working_assumptions.json, assumption_declared true — byte-identical in shape to the Impact/Implementation carriers, so W1 (assumed_claims_are_operator_declared) resolves it by declaration key. The 1.3 prose gained the standard qualifier: '— a production footprint carried as the operator's declared position pending the company's written confirmation.'

expected_effect.g11_p11: passes — no Tier 5 text asserts contribution to the Tier 2B Euratom impact; the substantive knowledge-transfer claim cites EI-06, which Tier 2B directly supports
expected_effect.g11_p13: passes — all three sections carry the AgroVIR footprint under the same declaration-keyed Assumed claim; nothing marks it Confirmed
expected_effect.staleness_cascade: Editing the drafts changes the recomposed excellence_section.json and impact_section.json, so under ST-1 content-based staleness the recorded gate_10a, gate_10b, gate_10d and gate_11 results go stale and those gates must be re-evaluated; gate_10c is untouched (implementation_section.json unchanged). Required rerun chain: n08a, n08b (decomposed-drafting supersession recomposes the sections from the corrected drafts without redrafting), n08d, n08e, n08f.

open_item.what: Tier 3 internal contradiction: capabilities.json CAP5 still states the 745,000-hectare footprint as Confirmed while the participant_capacity record and working_assumptions.json carry it as Assumed. Deliberately left to the operator — Tier 3 edits are operator-reviewed and fingerprinted by the authorisation record.
open_item.recommended_action: Either align CAP5 to Assumed with declaration key 'agrovir_relevant_track_record', or file AgroVIR's written confirmation (or the published-figures evidence) under source_materials/, retire the declaration into _superseded_and_removed, and promote the fact to Confirmed everywhere citing that source.
open_item.status_until_then: Assumed governs in all deliverables — a conscious, operator-owned green (mode β), not a fabricated Confirmed.
